name: raft
description: Golang implementation of the Raft consensus protocol

issues.title: asynchronous heartbeat can cause a stale leader to hold lease indefinitely during disk IO stall
Leadership election stuck in 3 node cluster in Candidate state.
Leader stopped sending appendEntries to the follower, but heartbeat was working
Enhancement: persist commit index in LogStore to accelerate recovery
Make Snapshots streamable by not requiring a known size up front.
Data divergence (Safety violation) due to Async Heartbeat
Leader election times seem too long with max current term

latest_release.name: v1.8.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

* This release removes the long-standing compatibiltiy shim between `hashicorp/go-metrics` and `armon/go-metrics`. You no longer need to set build tags when consuming this library. If you have other libraries that consume this library, you should upgrade them at the same time as your application.
* Raft now persists the commit index in the LogStore to accelerate recovery

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hashicorp/raft/compare/v1.7.3...v1.8.0
